chrome.phoneFrameNote: Shown in a phone frame: this role works on a mobile device.

ai.previewNote: Preview concept: mocked for this demo, not a shipped Kissflow capability.
ai.askPlaceholder: Ask about SLA, DLP cost, repeat faults, certificates, fleet…

sla.summerRule: Summer rule: AC uplifted to P2
sla.clockStarted: SLA clock started at first contact

compliance.title: Compliance wall
compliance.subtitle: Fire & life safety and statutory certificates, by building
compliance.hassantukNote: Status field only: no live Hassantuk integration in this demo.

command.title: Command centre
command.subtitle: Liability, time and assurance across the portfolio
command.batchAlertBody: {count} × “{cause}” in {days} days across batch {batch} (floors {from}–{to}), all installed by {sub}.

intake.title: Intake
intake.subtitle: Every channel lands as a timestamped work order with the SLA clock running
intake.readyNote: Shown as a pattern, not live. Would connect through a webhook trigger; needs validation.
intake.qrNote: QR posters in lift lobbies and on asset tags open a public request form. No login.

queue.title: Work orders
queue.empty: No work orders match these filters.
queue.emptyHint: Clear a filter or widen the date range.

wo.activityNote: Append-only: every event is timestamped and attributed. Entries are never edited.
wo.decennialNote: Statutory decennial liability applies to structural defects for ten years from handover. Engineering review required.

request.title: Report a problem
request.subtitle: We'll send the right team and keep you updated.
request.describePh: e.g. The AC isn't cooling, it's 29°C inside
request.photoHint: Helps the technician bring the right parts
request.sentBody: Reference {ref}. The SLA clock started at {time}.
request.tagNotFound: That tag isn't in the asset register. Please use the app or call the helpdesk.
request.aiSuggest: Suggest category & priority from the description

tech.scanHint: Point the camera at the QR tag on the unit
tech.cameraUnavailable: Camera not available here: use simulate or type the tag.
tech.challengeRepeat: Fault no. {n} on this unit in {days} days
tech.challengeSiblings: {n} units from the same batch ({batch}) recorded “{cause}” in the last 45 days
tech.challengeAsk: Re-test before confirming. Is “{cause}” really the root cause?
tech.doneDlp: Within DLP: back-charge will be raised to {sub} on verification.
tech.requiredFirst: Complete the checklist, pick a root cause and add an after photo.
